changes.staging: Keep the phone call and seated position. Add the hand-over-phone gesture and small bow. Aoi recognises “IT” and “B2”; Eric responds to her apology and face, not to Japanese he has not learned. The viewer supplies Japanese readings and English meanings; implementation must preserve the setting.md requirement that English is available.

changes.staging: The phone image must actually show him, the pitch and the readable score. Proposes an informal company football match yesterday, not a new event to attend or a sports minigame. His department is IT outside the already-established B2 team; do not add him to that team. Eric sees the English team label and the score.

changes.staging: Keep Hamada asleep for the existing arrival/rescue beat. Stage the phone buzz, hand movement and half-awake nod; do not display an invented current time or advance the clock. No extra wake-up branch.

あ、ごめん、ちょっと待って。: Oh, sorry, hang on a moment.
え？あ、あそこ、どうぞ。: Huh? Oh, over there. Go ahead.
え？…あっち、空いてる。: Huh? ... There’s a seat over there.
だから今日、配属が決まるの！どこでもいいけど、地下はいや。: Dakara kyō, haizoku ga kimaru no! Doko demo ii kedo, chika wa iya.
I told you, they decide my assignment today! Anywhere is fine, but I don’t want the basement.
うん、今日決まる。地下だけはやだな。: Un, kyō kimaru. Chika dake wa yada na.
Yes, they decide today. I just don’t want the basement.
ううん！窓が好きなだけ。: Uun! Mado ga suki na dake.
No! I just like having windows.
よかったら、どうぞ。駅で二つ買っちゃって。: Yokattara, dōzo. Eki de futatsu kacchatte.
Have one, if you like. I ended up buying two at the station.
会社のお菓子、もう飽きちゃって。: I’ve got tired of the company’s snacks.
昨日の試合。やっと一点取れた。: Kinō no shiai. Yatto itten toreta.
This was yesterday’s match. I finally managed to score.
あ、ごめん。音、漏れてた？: Oh, sorry. Could you hear that?

I recorded it myself yesterday. I’m still pretty bad, though.
会社のは古くて、同じボタンがないんだよ。: Kaisha no wa furukute, onaji botan ga nai n da yo.
The version at work is old. It doesn’t have the same buttons.
うん。会社の。: Yes, that’s the one at work.
